caption: Two 45-man Spearmen phalanxes grind head-on for the whole clip. Each is 9 files wide and only 5 ranks deep -- shallower than a spear's own 6-rank reach depth -- which is exactly the case that used to put EVERY soldier in SoldierBodies' engaged tier and leave no unengaged bulk to hold the formation's shape, so rank and file order churned indefinitely and men visibly slid sideways past their neighbours mid-melee. The body-dynamics tier is now scoped to bodily CONTACT depth (one rank at the standard rank pitch) instead of weapon reach, so only the men actually being shoved get the engaged treatment, and the ranks behind them keep dressing their files -- which is what holds the block's shape through the grind. Melee resolution is untouched: all six ranks of spears still strike, which is why the amber engaged-soldier highlight still covers both blocks entirely. That overlay reads the melee tier; the new physics tier has no on-screen representation, so the formation's own order is the thing to watch.
